candidate_provenance: Selected17676 raw review and compact DATA; no fit trajectory read.

derived_reporting.pair_sum_P: Sum literal34 pair cycles within each parent; includes N-fold ion subtraction.
derived_reporting.collective_B: C-P, not an additional independent response target.
derived_reporting.paired_forces: Dy-La from the same individual force arrays.
derived_reporting.paired_radial_work: Dy work-La work = displaced exchange-central exchange.
derived_reporting.field_increment: trimer-dimer for each metal; Dy-minus-La of increments also derived.
derived_reporting.field_row_independence: Two steps and two estimators measure the same four state susceptibilities; preserve all numerical comparisons, do not multiply their fitting weight.

consumed_regression_outside_proposed_fit.recommendation: Report every cycle and changes; do not move troublesome cycles into/out of the loss after viewing a fit.

existing_model_to_provisional_reference_.application: Every original10 energy and15 force gate, not only aggregate objective.

numerical_consistency_only.precision_bounds: Printing/CG/operator/finite-step allowances are not reference uncertainty or weights.

correlated_method_diagnostic_only.application: Reference approximation qualification; not a mechanics-fit error bar or replacement target.

conventions.reference_recipe: Uncorrected original ECP-PBE0-D4 energy/gradient; do not substitute CP or CC fragment energies
conventions.body_weight: Per category equal; within category equal bodies; within body equal response types and xyz. Ion net force only; water net force and centroid torque/1A.

recipe_separation: Original10 E/F use uncorrected frozen-f ECP-PBE0-D4 total surface.
Pair/C dipoles and E3/mu3 retain exact common-parent basis and original nuclear/electronic origins.
Trimer E3 uses electronic PBE0 without D4; do not substitute it for an original total-energy target.
No CP/correlated scalar is substituted into original E/F; W8/W9 correlation-method uncertainty remains unresolved.
force_requirements: Candidate conservative total energy, energy-conjugate moment and coordinate derivatives must refer to the same functional.
Include coordinate derivatives of local/collective shape functions, radial directions, native T and permanent multipole frames, and new short-range energy.
Saved fixed-geometry A/Ed/Ep matrices do not supply coordinate derivatives; original candidate force checks remain unevaluated until a separately qualified implementation provides them.

validation_division.consumed_data: All fitting and trimer-regression quantities here have already been inspected; no retrospective independence claim.

historical_water_orientation.authority: fresh_radial_declaration explicitly classifies earlier four orientations as historical regression evidence

validation_division.future_release: Existing held branch remains unchanged. Any future new-candidate binding must preserve original complete4/12 criteria and follow actual development/numerical/raw review; this contract releases no validation calls.
